newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom U.S. link in danger - report.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom U.S. link in danger - report.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom's planned alliance with France Telecom and U.S.-based Sprint Corp still risks veto by U.S. authorities, an advance copy of an article in Monday's "Der Spiegel" said.
According to the German magazine, the U.S. Federal Communications Commission will only approve the alliance when access to the German phone market is as free as it is in the United States.
The FCC last December approved the planned investment in Sprint by France Telecom and the soon-to-be-floated Deutsche Telekom.
"Der Spiegel" said that a representative of a German energy concern had now complained to the FCC that network access in Germany was way behind that in the U.S.

German utility groups such as Viag AG, Veba AG and RWE AG are all seeking to be major competitors in the German market when it is fully liberalised along with other European telecom industries in 1998.
